description: Prepare unparking: the partner vault named pays the wallet (amount, or all it can pay now: its free cash), and a new position is opened in [tickLower, tickUpper] of a pool gage_capabilities parkPools lists that pairs the vault's asset; a range around the price takes the pool's other token too, from the wallet. Its transactions are built from one reading of the chain: send them in order (calls) or as one batch, without preparing again between them. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

amount.description: How much to withdraw, raw units of the vault's asset; everything the vault can pay the wallet now when omitted

manager.description: Where the new position is minted: the pool's manager (gage_capabilities parkPools manager)

maxSlippageBps.description: Most the conversion may move against you, in bps; 50 when omitted

pool.description: The pool: a v3-style pool's address, or a v4 pool's id (gage_capabilities parkPools pool)

tickLower.description: The new range's lower tick, a multiple of the pool's tick spacing

tickUpper.description: The new range's upper tick, a multiple of the pool's tick spacing, above tickLower

vault.description: The partner vault to withdraw from: one whose asset the pool pairs

name: gage_prepare_unpark
title: Prepare: Unpark into a new position
